name: email-kit
title: Email Kit
description: Server-rendered HTML email: a layout with a text wordmark, light and dark colours from the design tokens, and the footer; parts (heading, text, button, card, quote, item list); three templates — Notification, Digest and Action — and renderEmail for the HTML and plain-text parts.

meta.whenToUse: Transactional and notification email from a server — a comment, an assignment, a daily digest, an invite or a password reset — rendered with renderEmail and sent by your mail provider.
meta.whenNotToUse: Marketing newsletters with images and multi-column layouts, or an in-app notification — use the Inbox and Toast components.
